description: This file defines the 'Channel' class within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, which extends WebSocket link functionality for handling WebSocket communication, JSON serialization/deserialization, and request management. It includes nested classes for packaging data, serializing, and deserializing JSON messages, and manages WebSocket states and message queues.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket channels, including message queuing, JSON serialization/deserialization, and state management.

classes.name: Channel::Package
classes.description: A helper class for encapsulating either JSON or text data to be sent over the channel.

classes.name: Channel::SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of JSON elements for outbound messages.

classes.name: Channel::DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming JSON messages.
